notes.title: Early Access Ends – Full Release Begins!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey stargazers! 

After an amazing journey in Early Access, our game is officially out in full release today—and fittingly, it launches under the shadow of the September 21st solar eclipse.[/p][p][/p][h2]Community-Driven Updates Since Early Access[/h2][p]Since our Early Access launch, the game has grown incredibly thanks to your feedback and support. During the 6-month EA period, we made over [b]130[/b] updates thanks to our small community's feedback. We will continue moving forward with the same dedication in the full release.[/p][p]Here are some highlights:[/p][list][*][p][b]Daily & Custom Modes:[/b] Inspired by realtime astrological events, every run can change dramatically.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ascensions:[/b] 20 ascension levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Bosses & Encounters:[/b] More enemies, more chaos, more challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Updates:[/b] Renewed animations and card icons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Updates:[/b] SFX effects and soundtrack pieces.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b] Map drawing and card layout configurations, run logs, card and boon codex, player profiles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Heroes & Cards: [/b]3 heroes, 200+ hero cards, 50+ elemental cards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boons: [/b]120+ zodiac boons and 20+ chaos boons. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's New in Full Release?[/h2][p]Twelve constellations. but three battles for purification. One inevitable truth: what you don't conquer becomes your doom. Each corrupted zodiac sign offers a choice—cleanse it now, or face its wrath later. [/p][p]Your ultimate enemy doesn't just await you—it's built from every constellation you couldn't save, creating a final encounter as unique as your path through the corrupted cosmos.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2][list][*][p]More zodiac & chaos boons (first patch)[/p][/*][*][p]Daily mode + leaderboard[/p][/*][*][p]Monthly balance updates[/p][/*][*][p]Community-driven improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b][i]To everyone who joined us in Early Access. You're the real stars of this journey. This eclipse is just the beginning. Thank you for being here.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nLy7miS3WPU;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Solar Eclipse Marks Our Full Release!
notes.notes: [h2]🌑 The Eclipse Brings Balance[/h2][p]As the cosmic forces align and the Moon casts its shadow across the Sun, [b]Moon's Creed[/b] emerges from Early Access into its full glory. This is no coincidence—the stars have chosen this moment.[/p][p][/p][h2]⚔️ A New Final Boss:[/h2][p]The twelve zodiac signs have fallen to corruption. Throughout your journey, you'll battle to purify these tainted constellations—but here's the twist: every zodiac you fail to cleanse becomes a weapon for the final boss. Leave Scorpio corrupted? Face its venomous strikes in your ultimate battle. Your final confrontation is shaped by your failures, making every showdown unique to your path through the stars.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/3a6d37fa06c66721124b1d3efe127a92c8f72a29.png"][/img][/p][h2]🌒 Full Version Features:[/h2][list][*][p][b]50+ Cards of Elemental Power[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]120+ Zodiac Boons[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]100+ Combat Effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]30+ Daily Challenges & Celestial Modifiers[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]20 Ascension Levels[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Daily Climbs Aligned with Astrological Events[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]67 Achievements[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]✨ As Above, So Below[/h2][p]To our Early Access community who've guided us like constellations in the night sky—this moment is yours too. Your feedback shaped every card, every mechanic, every choice.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The eclipse comes. The Zodiac awaits. Your creed demands answer.[/b][/p][p][i]"In the shadow of the eclipse, true power is revealed."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The Moon's Creed Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Map Drawing and Card Layout Update
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features [/h2][h3]🗺️ Map Drawing System[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/0b756b7cd20be2d6926e0277106b33bc66946cbf.png"][/img][/p][p]Players can now annotate their journey with a fully-featured drawing system!

[b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Drawing Tools[/b] - Draw directly on the map with customizable brush sizes and colors[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eraser Mode[/b] - Remove unwanted marks with adjustable eraser hardness[/p][/*][*][p][b]Persistent Annotations[/b] - All drawings are automatically saved per map and restored when revisiting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Undo/Redo Support[/b] - Made a mistake? Use undo/redo to perfect your annotations (up to 20 steps)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drawing Modes[/b] - Toggle between Draw, Erase, and Navigation modes seamlessly[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]How to Use:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Click the pencil icon to enter drawing mode[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll to adjust brush size while drawing[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click or press ESC to exit drawing mode [/p][/*][/list][h3]🎴 Card Layout Customization[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/591d41a27f071a217c26d2bae6e4ee9779eb90de.png"][/img][/p][p]Take full control of your card display with extensive customization options!

[b]Customizable Parameters:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Card Spacing & Width[/b] - Adjust how cards spread across your hand[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scale Settings[/b] - Control base card size, hover scale, and selected card scale[/p][/*][*][p][b]Position Offsets[/b] - Fine-tune vertical positioning for normal, middle, and hovered cards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animation Timing[/b] - Adjust animation speed for card movements and hover effects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rotation Controls[/b] - Customize card fan angle and rotation multiplier[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rainbow Arc Effect[/b] - Control the curve height of your card fan[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Additional Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Settings persist per player profile[/p][/*][*][p]Reset to defaults option available[/p][/*][*][p]Real-time preview of changes [/p][p]  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Drawing data is stored efficiently with automatic compression[/p][/*][*][p]Card layout changes apply immediately without restart[/p][/*][*][p]Both systems integrate seamlessly with existing UI elements
[/p][p][i]Note: The map drawing feature is designed to help players plan routes, mark important locations, or simply express creativity during their runs. All drawings are local to your profile and can be cleared at any time.[/i][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: August 14th, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Combat Node Save System: Fixed an issue where characters would spawn at incorrect locations when loading saved combat encounters
Card Rewards: Improved robustness of the card reward system and resolved a rare error that could cause reward screens to become unresponsive

notes.title: August 11th, 2025 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h2]Critical Bug Fixes[/h2]
Sagittarius Boss: Fixed a critical bug where the boss would attempt to add a curse card after the player's death, causing the game to become unresponsive
Memory Management: Resolved an issue with object poolers that was causing excessive RAM usage during gameplay

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]
Memory Optimization: Game now properly manages memory allocation, reducing overall system resource consumption


These fixes address stability issues and improve overall game performance. Thank you for your reports!

notes.title: August 11th, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
System Changes

Ascension Progression: Clarified ascension unlock system
Ascension Level 1 unlocks upon completing the normal game
Subsequent ascension levels unlock sequentially after winning the previous level

Starting Boon Requirement: Players must now select a starting boon before beginning a game
This was an oversight on our part and is now mandatory for all new runs

Important Notice
Saved Games: Due to the starting boon requirement, we recommend starting a new game rather than loading existing saves to avoid potential compatibility issues

Bug Fixes
Past Run Logs: Corrected translation errors in run history display
Card Reward Panel: Fixed issue where closing the panel during animations could cause card errors
Panel can no longer be closed while animations are playing

User Interface Improvements
Main Menu: Added direct access to the feedback panel from the main menu

We apologize for the inconvenience regarding saved games. The starting boon requirement ensures a more stable gameplay experience moving forward.

notes.title: August 9th, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Critical Bug Fixes
[/h2]
Act 3 Witch Combat: Resolved a critical bug that was causing the witch encounter to soft lock during combat
Combat System: Fixed a major logic issue that could cause combat to freeze, preventing progression
Boon Unlocks: Corrected functionality issues with boon unlock mechanics
[h2]System Improvements
[/h2]
Ascension Mode: Fixed ascension system functionality and added informational tooltips

Cards

notes.title: Moon's Creed - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the Early Access release of our studio's first game, Moon's Creed!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2340510/

[h2]About the Game[/h2]
Moon's Creed offers an experience where you build strategic decks using zodiac powers, battle against constellations corrupted by chaos, and change the fate of the cosmos. Strategic deck-building, boons from 12 zodiac signs, 3 different heroes, chaos rooms, and high replayability invite you to a new adventure every time!

Every game is unique! You can engage in challenging battles in Chaos Rooms, increase your power with Astral Boons, and discover new strategies on randomly generated maps. With full modding support, you can create your own content and enjoy endless replayability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/b45a184648eba5742166b815ff5f29c4e499f11c.gif[/img]

[h2]Early Access Process
[/h2]After a development period of more than a year and a half, this stage is an important milestone for us to fully realize the potential of Moon's Creed. Currently, the game includes:

- Strategic deck building system
- 3 playable heroes
- Various zodiac powers and boons
- Chaos rooms and randomly generated maps
- Modding support

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/853663559e2776193f303f30dfe49ad72ce24442.png[/img]

[h2]Player Feedback
[/h2]Since the beginning of the development process, feedback from our player community has formed the foundation of our design. Therefore, we stay in constant communication with you through our Discord channel, evaluating your opinions on balance adjustments, narrative, and gameplay mechanics, and sharing our new content with you in advance.

Don't miss the opportunity to shape the future of the game by participating in Moon's Creed's Early Access process. Let's change the fate of the cosmos together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758352/d15a5af50ffc65683491e5d2a35b1898dc3bbd04.png[/img]
